biography:
I am a seasoned data center and construction professional with 35 years of experience delivering high performance, scalable and maintainable mission-critical facilities. With deep expertise in AI GPU requirements, I've specialized in integrating AI/ML environment solutions into next generation data centers. My passion for innovation has driven me to stay at the forefront of emerging technologies, including liquid cooling to the chip, modular designs and sustainable product implementations. I have extensive experience leading and guiding professional design staff, consultants, and diverse functional units within complex organizations in the development of hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data centers. My career path has included working with global technology firms, industry leading architects and engineering teams in the development of large cluster GPU deployments, edge computing and cloud-based infrastructure. As an experienced leader I have managed teams through all phases of the project life cycle, from site selection and due diligence through start-up/commissioning and operations.
As a passionate whitewater enthusiast, environmental stewardship lives deeply at my core and as we continue to shape the future of digital infrastructure, sustainability is key component to the success of our industry.
Executive level Program Manager with 28 years of Construction, Project Management, Design, Advanced Planning and Estimating Experience. Having worked on hundreds of projects ranging in value from a few million dollars to over a billion dollars has allowed me develop a very unique skill set that includes: conceptual & advanced planning, budgeting, estimating and significant contract and project management experience. While at Bank of America, I consulted with the Critical Facility, Data Center, Vertical Construction, Mergers & Acquisitions and Retail Bank teams. I supported the portfolio globally, this included Estimating, Project Management and Design expertise on over $2B annually. I have significant experience in overseeing and guiding professional staff, consultants and diverse functional units within complex organizations. Other processes I managed include issuing and responding to RFP's, which include services for Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Consultants and Commissioning. In addition I have led major initiatives to purchase long lead equipment, commodities and services on an enterprise level. Prior experience also included orchestrating all phases of the project lifecycle, from initial conceptual definition through design; construction and start-up for major projects in healthcare, mixed use projects, entertainment; and complex commercial construction projects. My services have also been deployed to recover troubled projects, and in many situations this restored client trust and generated additional business opportunities.
